# Slipstream

> Local tool-output compression for GitHub Copilot and other MCP clients, with retrievable artifacts and measured token savings.

Slipstream is installed from this source checkout, not a published npm package.
It uses MCP over stdio. It does not intercept model requests or act as a provider proxy.
Relative links below resolve from the repository root.

## Installation and Tools

- [Canonical server manifest](server.json): Local identity, prerequisites, launch arguments, and tool names by mode; not a public registry listing.
- [MCP integration](docs/mcp.md): Source installation, standalone and retrieval-only modes, live tool discovery, and configuration.
- [Project README](README.md): Copilot CLI quick start, VS Code setup, settings, and security boundaries.
- [Packaging](docs/packaging.md): Building and installing local packages and the extension.

## Recovery and Safety

- [Recovery limits and security](docs/mcp.md#recovery-and-security): Stored representations, retention limits, workspace access, and command execution.
- [Security boundaries](README.md#security): Command allowlisting, path restrictions, untrusted output, and artifact storage.

Omission markers reference stored artifact ranges. Retrieve those ranges while
available; expired or evicted artifacts require rerunning the command or rereading
the file. Line omissions preserve stored text; JSON formatting, ANSI removal, path
folding, and marker sanitization mean retrieval is not always the original raw bytes.

## Development

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Package responsibilities, compressors, profiles, and integration boundaries.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Bootstrap, required validation, and publication approval boundaries.
- [MCP smoke tests](packages/mcp-server/test/smoke.test.ts): Live tools/list checks and tool behavior.
